summary.text: Wife of Lacritus (`lacritus-boeotian`) and mother of Leïtus and Clonius in Hyginus' catalogue — distinct from Cleobule mother of Eurythemis in Apollodorus' Calydonian stemma.

story.text: Hyginus names Leïtus and Clonius as sons of Lacritus and Cleobule, captains of twelve and nine Boeotian ships at Troy.
